items.message: ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL is fetched from the environment and used as the target of an outbound HTTP request. If an attacker can set that variable before the process starts (e.g., a compromised step in a composite action that runs before this one), they control the URL the resolver fetches the token from — and therefore control what value is minted and seeded into the redaction registry as a trusted credential.
